name: MARIENBAD
author: optim-agent
description:
Nim. Clue is 3-5 heap sizes ('5 7 9 3'), always an N-position (xor != 0). A solution is the
heap sizes AFTER one legal move: same number of heaps, no heap larger than before, exactly one
heap strictly smaller, and the xor of the new sizes must be 0 (the winning reply).
DIFFICULTY: medium. Named for 'Last Year at Marienbad', the film whose game is Nim.
DISCOVERY PATH: the demo shows an answer that is a near-copy of the clue with one number
reduced -- so the move format is free. The aha is *which* reduction: xor everything, then set
heap i to h[i] xor total for the i where that shrinks it. Teams first try 'take the biggest
heap' style heuristics and score ~0-20%, which is a clear signal that a rule is hiding.
Echoing the clue scores 0 by construction (its xor is non-zero and nothing shrank).
